scripts.build: npm run build -w @brusshy/core && npm run build -w @brusshy/shapes && npm run build -w @brusshy/studio && npm run build -w brusshy
scripts.test: npm test -w @brusshy/core && npm test -w @brusshy/shapes && npm test -w brusshy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/shapes && tsc -p packages/studio --noEmit && tsc -p packages/brusshy --noEmit
